enriched_activities.desc: Lie down in bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Fall asleep. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Straighten legs. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Push blanket. Turn to back. Stretch arms. Remain asleep.
Wake up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Pick out clothes. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Check bag contents. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and cereal. Take out bowl and spoon. Pour cereal. Pour milk. Sit and eat. Drink milk. Rinse bowl. Place in dishwasher. Walk out.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Greet colleague. Walk to locker. Put on uniform. Walk to station.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at station. Check patient charts. Wash hands. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update records. Attend meeting. Discuss cases. Take notes. Respond to call light. Assist patient. Walk to break room. Eat lunch. Return to station. Review test results. Consult with doctor. Document care. End shift.

Leave workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Read news. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house. Remove shoes. Hang coat. Walk to living room.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Serve on plate. Sit and eat. Drink water. Clear table. Rinse dishes. Place in dishwasher. Walk out.

Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Watch program. Adjust volume. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Walk back. Sit down. Continue watching. Turn off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer and phone, checking storm updates and charging devices
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Plug in phone charger. Connect phone to charger. Open browser. Check weather website. Read storm updates. Open email. Reply to messages. Open social media. Scroll through feed. Watch video. Close browser. Unplug charger. Pick up phone. Check battery. Plug in laptop charger. Turn off computer. Close laptop.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.
Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down.
Lie down in bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Fall asleep. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to other side. Sleep. Stretch legs. Sleep. Pull blanket. Sleep. Remain asleep.
